// diagnostic E0802

Jet.CallOnFunctionValue

This function value is called through `.call(…)`

What

This function value is called through `.call(…)`

Why

A function value is called with plain parentheses; `.call(…)` only selects a callable field that shares its name with a method

Fix

Remove `.call` and write `callee(…)`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.CallOnFunctionValue: Tests/UI/E0802_call_on_function_value.stderr.

 Fix: Remove `.call` and write `callee(…)`
